title: Victims of BitConnect Scheme to Receive More than $17 Million to Compensate for Losses
publisher: U.S. Attorney's Office, Southern District of California
notes: Primary U.S. government source stating that a federal judge ordered Glenn Arcaro to pay $17,646,801 in restitution to approximately 800 victims in more than 40 countries. This supports a partial recovery/distribution milestone for identified victims, not a complete BitConnect-wide recovery rate.

title: U.S. Attorney's Office Collects $30.7 Million in Civil and Criminal Actions in Fiscal Year 2023
publisher: U.S. Attorney's Office, Southern District of California
notes: Primary follow-up confirming that bitcoin recovered in United States v. Glenn Arcaro was sold and resulted in $17,647,813 in restitution paid directly to victims, plus $1,003,900.17 in additional forfeited funds for victims. These figures establish realized enforcement-linked recovery but not full repayment of all BitConnect losses.
